title: Two-tape nondeterministic machine code
statement: A code for a nondeterministic Turing machine consists of a natural number $n$ and a nondeterministic machine with two work tapes, binary tape symbols, and state set $\{0,\ldots,n\}$; thus the state-count parameter is one less than the number of states.
hypotheses_covered: The state-count parameter n is a natural number.
The underlying machine is nondeterministic with two work tapes over Boolean symbols.
The state set is Fin (n + 1), hence has n + 1 states.
